overview.title: The people behind the learning
overview.intro: Keep each learner’s profile accurate, useful, and limited to the information tutoring actually needs.
overview.parentIntro: How tutors and the support team should reach you.
overview.privacy: We do not ask for a home address or an exact birth date. Student age is stored as a month and year or an age band.
overview.studentsIntro: Every minor stays connected to a parent account.
overview.parentFirstText: Create the parent profile on the left before adding a student.
